subject.title: Request: Add Discord reaction event support to Hooks system

question: Should OpenClaw add generic observation-only reaction hook names and payloads to the public plugin API now, and should the first implementation be Discord-only or cross-channel?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap, but the permanent public API shape affects third-party plugins and cross-channel semantics, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve generic observation hooks
options.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first with tests/docs, and leave clear room for Slack, Matrix, and WhatsApp parity.

options.title: Scope Discord first
options.body: Accept a Discord-first contract now, with explicit follow-up requirements so cross-channel payload drift does not become permanent.

options.title: Defer the API surface
options.body: Keep reaction automation on system events or external workarounds until maintainers are ready to sponsor a broader plugin-hook design.

recommendation.title: Approve generic observation hooks
recommendation.body: Add `reaction_added` and `reaction_removed` as observation-only hooks with a shared payload shape, wire Discord first with tests/docs, and leave clear room for Slack, Matrix, and WhatsApp parity.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent hook-context work and review metadata make this the best available owner for the public hook-contract decision, with Discord input from steipete likely needed.
